links.outcome: Chest CT referral rate, including referrals with negative CT results, with versus without AI-CAD
links.effect: AI-CAD use was associated with increased chest CT referrals (OR 1.33; P=0.008) and referrals with negative CT results (OR 1.46; P=0.005). Referrals with positive CT results were not significantly changed (OR 1.08; P=0.647).
links.quote: The use of AI-CAD for CR interpretation in pulmonology outpatients was independently associated with an increased frequency of overall referrals for chest CT scans and referrals with subsequent negative results.

screen.reason: The study evaluates the downstream clinical impact (referral rates to chest CT) of implementing an AI-CAD tool for chest radiographs in routine outpatient pulmonology practice, but it evaluates the deployment of the tool itself rather than testing a specific safeguard or deployment practice.
